name: NVR INC
business: NVR builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums under Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes to first-time, move-up and luxury buyers, plus mortgage services.

events.what: Director appointed (Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee)
Annual option grants to Executive Chairman, CEO, CFO and CAO tied to 2026-2028 return on capital; no role change
Last CEO change (outside window): internal successor Eugene Bredow named President and CEO; Paul Saville to Executive Chairman
events.from: President of NVR Mortgage; NVR since 2004

next_event.source: NVR holds no earnings calls or investor days and gives no guidance (Baba data_profile guidance state no_call; corpus holds filings only). Next item is the Q3 2026 results 8-K (date not confirmed).

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: NVR gives no guidance and no margin target. The only management margin commentary is the 10-Q MD&A explaining homebuilding gross margin (19.2% in Q2 2026) by lot costs, affordability pricing pressure, consumer sentiment and land deposit impairments. EBITDA margin figures are Visible Alpha consensus.

statements.quote: Gross profit margin percentage in the second quarter of 2026 decreased to 19.2% from 21.5% in the second quarter of 2025. Gross profit margin was negatively impacted by higher lot costs, pricing pressure due to continued affordability challenges and weak consumer sentiment.
statements.speaker: Company filing (MD&A)

street.gap_assumption: No management target, so no gap. December fiscal year; Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years.

evidence_of_progress.note: Homebuilding gross margin, not EBITDA: Q1 2026 19.6% vs 21.9% (-228 bps, derived from six-month less Q2 figures) and Q2 2026 19.2% vs 21.5% (-230 bps), 10-Q 0000906163-26-000093. Margins are still falling with the housing cycle; New Orders +9% in Q2 at 5% lower prices.

disqualifier_reason: Two disqualifiers. (1) No catalyst: CEO Bredow (internal) has been in seat since 2022-05-04 and the CFO is unchanged; two director additions are not a leadership change, and nothing is pending. (2) Margin is cycle and input-price driven: the 10-Q attributes the margin decline to lot costs, affordability-driven pricing and consumer sentiment, not to anything management can self-help, which is the commodity-style disqualifier. NVR's forward EBITDA margin (13.1%) is also above the industry median (9.6%), so the below-peer premise fails. D=2 is the mechanical result of a stabilized 4-month revision (-1.8%) with no stated level, not evidence of an unmodeled story.
verdict: Not a GXO setup: an above-peer-margin homebuilder with no leadership change, no guidance and margins set by the housing cycle.
open_questions: Is the 4-month stabilization in FY2027 EBITDA (-1.8%) a trough in homebuilding gross margin or a pause?
Do contract land deposit impairments ($21.7M in Q2 2026) keep rising as lot costs reset?
Does Executive Chairman Saville's role change in the next proxy, which would be the only plausible leadership catalyst?
